title: Monotonicity of $L^r$ norms under the uniform measure
statement:
Let $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function, and let $r,s$ be real numbers with $1\le r\le s$. Writing $\E$ for the expectation under the uniform probability measure on $\{0,1\}^n$, the $L^r$ norm of $f$ is bounded by its $L^s$ norm:
\[
  \big(\E\big[\,|f|^{r}\,\big]\big)^{1/r}\;\le\;\big(\E\big[\,|f|^{s}\,\big]\big)^{1/s}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
replaced:
For $1 \le r \le s$ and any $f : \mathrm{BoolCube}\,n \to \bbr$,
\[
  \big(\E[|f|^r]\big)^{1/r} \le \big(\E[|f|^s]\big)^{1/s}.
\]
This is the power-mean inequality for the uniform probability measure on the cube.
